implementation_risks: Platform usage currently writes AnalyticsEvent with actor tenant; analytics is not AuditLog authority and the target event is PLATFORM-scoped.
UID reconciliation is a mutating GET with implicit target semantics and no audit; target is explicit platform-only POST.
Team services admit platform_admin through service-level guards; target admin routes exclude it.
Pending/approve/reject and admin feedback/user baseline paths contain cross-tenant or missing-tenant branches.
Pipeline-stage and tag ID mutations lack explicit ID plus tenant predicates.
Admin user PATCH currently permits assigning platform_admin; target admin schema must forbid it.
The four currently audited superadmin targets have success-path evidence only; all ten still require success and failure audit, outbox, scope, and idempotency.
